title: Repeated failed delivery attempts and scheduling issues
situation: Customers are reporting multiple missed delivery appointments and inconsistent tracking updates, requiring immediate intervention to prevent further frustration.
hypothesis: Incorrect address details causing delivery failure

params.reply_en: I am sorry for the repeated delivery failures. I am escalating this to our logistics team to verify your address and ensure your order is prioritized for the next available slot.
params.reply_ar: نعتذر عن تكرار فشل التوصيل. قمت بتصعيد الطلب لفريق الخدمات اللوجستية للتحقق من العنوان وضمان أولوية التوصيل في أقرب وقت ممكن.

actions.why: Acknowledge the frustration and confirm that the delivery issue is being investigated by the logistics team.

params.note: Multiple reports of repeated missed deliveries and conflicting scheduling information. Please verify address accuracy and delivery status.

actions.why: The issue involves repeated failures that require manual intervention from the logistics team to resolve.

reply_en: I am sorry for the repeated delivery failures. I am escalating this to our logistics team to verify your address and ensure your order is prioritized for the next available slot.

reply_other.es: Lamento los fallos repetidos en la entrega. He escalado este caso a nuestro equipo de logística para verificar su dirección y asegurar que su pedido tenga prioridad en la próxima entrega disponible.

alternatives.hypothesis: Courier failing to follow delivery instructions
alternatives.why: Customers explicitly mention missed instructions and driver no-shows.

alternatives.hypothesis: Systemic delay in the local distribution center
alternatives.why: The pattern of repeated missed dates suggests a bottleneck at the facility level.
